questions.q: In Veeru Bhai Pvt. limited company 60% of the employees are men and 48% of the employees are engineers and 66.66% of these are men. The percentage of women who are <u>not</u> engineers:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab aise percentages of percentages me exam setter khel raha ho, toh total employees ko aankh band karke $100$ maan le. Language ki trap ye hai ki base kiske reference me pucha gaya hai, wo dekhna bahut zaroori hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total $100$ leke branches bana aur jo manga hai wo seedha nikal!

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Total} = 100 \implies \text{Men} = 60, \text{Women} = 40$$
$$\text{Total Engg} = 48$$
$$\text{Men Engg} = \frac{2}{3} \times 48 = 32$$
$$\text{Women Engg} = 48 - 32 = 16$$
$$\text{Non-Engg Women} = 40 - 16 = 24$$
$$\text{Req } \% = \frac{24}{40} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Galti se usko total employees ($100$) se divide mat kar dena. Language ke hisaab se denominator sirf women hongi.

Mathematically :-
$$\text{Base} = 40 \text{ (Total Women)}$$
$$\text{Percentage} = \frac{24}{40} \times 100 = 60\%$$

Exam Takeaway: Percentage kiske 'respect' me pucha gaya hai (yaani Base kya hai), usko exam paper me hamesha underline kar liya kar!

List IList II
Language TrapDenominator is Total Women

questions.q: Rajan spent $10\%$ of his salary on rent. He spent $20\%$ of the remaining part of the salary on transport. After which he spent $40\%$ of the balance of the salary on food. Further, he spent $80\%$ of the balance on various bills. He deposits $\text{Rs. } 5000$ in the bank and kept the remaining $\text{Rs. } 1480$ for his own petty expenditure. Find his monthly salary (in Rs.).
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, bar-bar 'remaining part' likha hai, seedha Successive Change ka chain lagana hai. End me jo bhi paisa bacha (bank me daala + khud rakha) wo sab final remainder hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Final amount bacha $5000 + 1480 = 6480$. Salary ko $S$ maan aur seedha bachi hui fractions likh: $10\%$ kharch $\to \frac{9}{10}$ bacha, $20\% \to \frac{4}{5}$, $40\% \to \frac{3}{5}$, $80\% \to \frac{1}{5}$. Equation bani: $S \times \frac{9}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{1}{5} = 6480$. Upar walon ko multiply karega toh $9 \times 4 \times 3 = 108$ aayega. $108$ se $6480$ kata $60$ baar me. Neeche ka base $10 \times 5 \times 5 \times 5 = 1250$ udhar jake multiply hua. $S = 60 \times 1250 = 75000$. Secondon me uda diya bhai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Ya fir aise decimals me likh: $S \times 0.9 \times 0.8 \times 0.6 \times 0.2 = 6480$. $9 \times 8 \times 6 \times 2 = 864$ aayega. Yani $S \times 0.0864 = 6480$. $S = \frac{6480}{0.0864} = 75000$. Digital Sum bhi check kar sakta hai par itna sidha cut raha hai ki zaroorat nahi. Exam Takeaway: 'Of the remaining' padhte hi fractions ki chain bana kar directly equate kar diya kar.
Fraction ChainFinal Equate
$\frac{9}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{5} \times \frac{1}{5}$$\frac{108}{1250}$
$S \times \frac{108}{1250} = 6480$$S = 75000$

questions.q: In a Class of MBA Students 16.66% students from Science Background and 12.5% students are from commerce background and 6.66% students from arts background and rest from Engineering Background. The minimum Possible students of Engineering background?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Ye sab standard fractions ki game hai: $\frac{1}{6}$, $\frac{1}{8}$, aur $\frac{1}{15}$. Insaano ko fraction me tod nahi sakte na, isiliye total bache denominators ke LCM ke multiple hone chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, LCM le le denominators (6, 8, 15) ka, jo ki 120 aayega.
Iska matlab minimum class size $= 120$.
Total baaki streams ke bacche $= \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{8} + \frac{1}{15} = \frac{20+15+8}{120} = \frac{43}{120}$.
Toh engineering wale bache honge: $120 - 43 = 77$. Seedha 77 tick kar!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fractional logic samjh: Ek base minimum ek aisa number hona chahiye jo in sab denominators se puri tarah divide ho jaaye, taki students hamesha integer me hi niklen.

Exam Takeaway: Ulat pulat percentages ko fauran fractions me convert karke denominators ka LCM lekar unhe integer bana diya kar.

Fractions UsedEquivalent Value
16.66%, 12.5%, 6.66%1/6, 1/8, 1/15

questions.q: The lengths of two adjacent sides of a square are increased by $35\%$ and $25\%$ respectively. As a result the area of the rectangle will be more than the area of the square by?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 2D figure ka area $L \times B$ hota hai. Dono badh rahe hain, toh net successive percentage seedha hit karna hai formula se.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Aankh band karke $A + B + \frac{AB}{100}$ thok de. $35 + 25 + (35 \times 25)/100 = 60 + 8.75 = 68.75\%$. Options me last digit pehchano, pen mat uthana aisi calculations ke liye!

Mathematically :-
$\% = 35 + 25 + \frac{35 \times 25}{100}$
$\% = 60 + 8.75 = 68.75\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Square ki side 100 maan, area 10000. Nayi side 135 aur 125. Multiply kar aur difference dekh kar 100 se divide. Kyu karna itna dukh?

Mathematically :-
$A_{old} = 100 \times 100 = 10000$
$A_{new} = 135 \times 125 = 16875$
$\% = \frac{6875}{10000} \times 100 = 68.75\%$

Exam Takeaway: Area change hamesha $X+Y+XY/100$ format follow karta hai, time and mind space dono save karo.

FormulaApplication
Net Change$A + B + (A \times B)/100$

questions.q: For the Couse of corona various govt told that some employee stays at home so in an organization yesterday 13% male and 20% female employee were absent but today 8% female and 31% male employee are absent but number of male and female are equal present today. If Total number of employees present were 3528 in the organisation yesterday then find total number of employees in the organisation?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Aaj (today) ke data se 'present equal' wali line humko direct ratio nikal ke degi male-to-female ka. Ek baar ratio nikal gaya toh '100x' variable use kar ke calculations me point laane se bach jayenge.





Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai, aaj ki present halat par gaur kar.
Today Present Male $= (100 - 31)\% = 69\% M$.
Today Present Female $= (100 - 8)\% = 92\% F$.
Dono ko barabar rakh: $0.69 M = 0.92 F \implies \frac{M}{F} = \frac{92}{69} = \frac{4}{3}$
Ab assume kar le $M = 400x$ aur $F = 300x$. Toh Total hua $= 700x$.
Kal (Yesterday) kya scene tha: Present $M = 87\% \text{ of } 400x = 348x$.
Present $F = 80\% \text{ of } 300x = 240x$.
Total Yesterday Present $= 348x + 240x = 588x$.
Ye 588x diya hai 3528 ke barabar.
$$588x = 3528 \implies x = \frac{3528}{588} = 6$$
Total employees huye $700 \times 6 = 4200$. Ekdum pro wala attack hai!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute terms nikalne se pehle humesha conditions ka istemal kar ke seedha ratios set kar liya kar, time zero barbaad hoga.

Exam Takeaway: Ratio lock hote hi '00x' (hundred-x) approach lagana percentage extracting ko hamesha integers me badal deta hai.

Equating MethodZeroes Trick
Ratio GenerationFind ratio first, then append '00x' to make percentage calculation integer-based.

questions.q: The monthly salary of a person was 50,000. He used to spend on three heads-personal and family expenses (E), taxes (T), philanthropy (P), and rest were his savings. E was $50\%$ of the income. T was $20\%$ of E and P was $15\%$ of T. When his salary got raised by $40\%$, he maintained the percentage level of E, but T became $30\%$ of E and P became $20\%$ of T.By what percentage is the new savings more or less than the earlier savings? (correct up to one decimal place)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, fir se exam setter ne 50k deke trap set kiya hai. Answer percentage me chahiye, toh initial salary 100 maan, calculation makkhan ki tarah hogi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Base I=100. E=50. T(20% of 50)=10. P(15% of 10)=1.5. Old Save = 100-61.5 = 38.5. Nayi Income=140. E wahi 50% rahega yani E=70. Naya T(30% of 70)=21. Naya P(20% of 21)=4.2. New Save = 140-95.2 = 44.8. Diff = 6.3. $\frac{6.3}{38.5}$ nikal ke mark kar!

Mathematically :-
$I_1 = 100, E_1 = 50, T_1 = 10, P_1 = 1.5$
$\text{Save}_1 = 100 - 61.5 = 38.5$
$I_2 = 140, E_2 = 70, T_2 = 21, P_2 = 4.2$
$\text{Save}_2 = 140 - 95.2 = 44.8$
$\text{Diff} = 6.3$
$\% = \frac{6.3}{38.5} \times 100 = 16.36\%$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Pura 50,000 par nikalega, toh end me values hazaaro me chali jayengi fir unka ratio lega toh waise bhi zeros cancel ho jayenge. Gaddha mat khod exam me.

Mathematically :-
$I_1 = 50000$
$\text{Save}_1 = 50000 - 30750 = 19250$
$I_2 = 70000$
$\text{Save}_2 = 70000 - 47600 = 22400$
$\% = \frac{3150}{19250} \times 100 = 16.36\%$

Exam Takeaway: Absolute value avoid kar aur jab parameters interlinked ho, toh bas successive tree banata chal.

StateSavings
Old$38.5$ units
New$44.8$ units

questions.q: In the year 2014, the population of a city was 30,000. The population of the city increased in 2015, 2016 and 2017 by a constant number. In the year 2018, if the population of the city was increased by 20% over the previous year then the population of the city become 27600 more than that of the year 2014. What is the ratio of the percentage increase in the population of the city over the previous year in the year 2015 to that in the year 2017 over the previous year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, "constant number" matlab AP chal rahi hai. 2018 ki population $2014 + 27600$ se aayegi, phir $20\%$ back karke 2017 ka pata chalega. Reverse calculations kar mentally.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse series laga aur yearly increase nikal. Mathematically :-

$P_{2018} = 30000 + 27600 = 57600$

$P_{2017} = \frac{57600}{1.2} = 48000$

$\text{Inc in 3 yrs} = 48000 - 30000 = 18000 \Rightarrow \text{6000 per yr}$

$\%_{2015} = \frac{6000}{30000} = \frac{1}{5}$

$\%_{2017} = \frac{6000}{42000} = \frac{1}{7}$

$\text{Ratio} = \frac{1}{5} : \frac{1}{7} = 7 : 5$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables assume karke AP ka formula chalao. Mathematically :-

$P_{2014} = 30000$

$P_{2017} = 30000 + 3d$

$(30000 + 3d) \times 1.2 = 57600$

$30000 + 3d = 48000 \Rightarrow 3d = 18000 \Rightarrow d = 6000$

$\frac{6000}{30000} : \frac{6000}{30000+2(6000)} = \frac{1}{5} : \frac{1}{7} = 7:5$

Exam Takeaway: Constant increase humesha Arithmetic Progression (AP) hota hai, pichhe se backward aana smart move hai.

List IList II
AP Logic$\text{Value} = a + (n-1)d$

questions.q: Varun gave $60\%$ of the money he had to his wife. He also gave $20\%$ of the remaining amount to each of his three children. Three-fifth of the amount now left was spent on miscellaneous items, and the remaining amount of $\text{Rs. } 9,600$ was deposited in the bank. How much money did Varun have initially?:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, tree method ya successive line dono se chalega! Par language me bacha kar chalna hai: '20% to each of his three children' bole toh $20 \times 3 = 60\%$ of remaining kharch hua hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Initial amount ko 100 maan le. 60 wife ko de diya, bacha 40. Ab is 40 ka $60\%$ (20% x 3 bachhe) usne de diya. $40$ ka $60\% = 24$. Ab bacha $40 - 24 = 16$. Is 16 me se 'Three-fifth' (yani $\frac{3}{5}$) usne miscellaneous me uda diya. Toh bacha kitna? $\frac{2}{5}$ hissa. $16$ ka $\frac{2}{5} = 6.4$ unit bacha. Question ke hisab se $6.4$ unit = 9600. Pucha total (100 unit) hai. $\frac{9600}{6.4} \times 100 = 1500 \times 100 = 1,50,000$. Done! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Straight chain fraction bana le: $x \times (1 - 0.6) \times (1 - 0.6) \times (1 - 3/5) = 9600$. Yani $x \times 0.4 \times 0.4 \times 0.4 = 9600$. $x \times 0.064 = 9600 \implies x = 1,50,000$. Exam Takeaway: Examiner 'each' word daal kar hamesha trap karta hai, usay nazarandaaz mat karna.
DistributionRemaining Amount (Base 100)
After Wife ($60\%$)40
After Children ($60\%$)16
After Misc ($3/5$)6.4 units

questions.q: A student scored $20\%$ more marks in Math than in Science. If the average of his marks in both subjects is 66, what are his marks in Science? (CHSL TIER I-$\frac{15}{11}$/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, Math me Science se $20\%$ zyada hai matlab ratio 6:5 aayega. Dono ka average 66 hai toh total 132 hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha ratio equate kar. Mathematically :-
$$Ratio = 6:5 \Rightarrow Total = 11$$
$$11 \rightarrow 132$$
$$1 \rightarrow 12$$
$$Science (5) \rightarrow 60$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Fraction concept se. Mathematically :-
$$20\% = \frac{1}{5}$$
$$M:S = 6:5$$
$$Avg = \frac{11}{2} = 5.5 \rightarrow 66$$
$$1 \rightarrow 12$$
$$Science = 5 \times 12 = 60$$

Exam Takeaway: Fraction aur unit method se average seconds me nikalta hai, x assume mat karna kabhi.

List IList II
Fraction Logic$20\%$ more means direct 6:5 ratio on base 5.

questions.q: The current population of a district is 9500. If the male population is increased by $14.2 \%$ and the female population is increased by $17.7 \%$, the total population of the district becomes 11003. If out of the total male population $15 \%$ are young boys and out of the total female population $18 \%$ are young girls, then find the difference between the number of young boys and young girls.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM/Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, dono male aur female $14.2 \%$ toh badhe hi hain. Jo extra $3.5 \%$ ka increase hai wo sirf females ki wajah se total excess me aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique): Minimum base pakad aur extra value ko compare kar. Junior Satisfaction Method (JSM) se seedha female population aayegi.

Mathematically :-

$$ \text{Total Increase} = 11003 - 9500 = 1503 \\ \text{Base Increase (if both } 14.2\%) = 9500 \times 14.2 \% = 1349 \\ \text{Extra Increase} = 1503 - 1349 = 154 \\ 3.5 \% \text{ of Females} = 154 \implies \text{Females} = \frac{154 \times 100}{3.5} = 4400 \\ \text{Males} = 9500 - 4400 = 5100 \\ \text{Boys} = 15 \% \text{ of } 5100 = 765 \\ \text{Girls} = 18 \% \text{ of } 4400 = 792 \\ \text{Difference} = 792 - 765 = 27 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable maan ke basic equation bana le par exam me thoda time khayega.

Mathematically :-

$$ M + F = 9500 \\ 1.142 M + 1.177 F = 11003 \\ 1.142(9500 - F) + 1.177 F = 11003 \\ 10849 - 1.142 F + 1.177 F = 11003 \\ 0.035 F = 154 \implies F = 4400, M = 5100 \\ \text{Diff} = (0.18 \times 4400) - (0.15 \times 5100) = 792 - 765 = 27 $$

Exam Takeaway: JSM wahan hamesha lagana jahan total ke do parts ho aur dono ka alag alag percentage change diya ho. Baseline same karke calculation asan ho jati hai.

PopulationGrowth Split
Males$14.2 \%$
Females$14.2 \% + 3.5 \%$

questions.q: In an election between three candidates, the third-placed candidate received 1000 valid votes. From the remaining votes, the elected candidate received 5000 more votes than the runner-up candidate, accounting for $52\%$ of the total votes cast. If $16\%$ of votes were declared invalid (given that all the voters cast their vote), then the total number of cast votes was?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, variables ko total ke percentage terms me rakh kar equation balance karni hai, seedha $20x$ ki value aayegi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): W aur R ka gap base pakad. Mathematically :-
$$52x - (84x - 52x - 1000) = 5000$$
$$20x = 4000 \Rightarrow 100x = 20000$$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Tree distribution method. Mathematically :-
$$Valid = 100x - 16x = 84x$$
$$W + R + 1000 = 84x$$
$$R = 32x - 1000$$
$$W - R = 5000$$
$$20x = 4000 \Rightarrow x = 200 \Rightarrow 100x = 20000$$

Method 3: 52% W ko toh Runner ko 52%-5k ATQ winner ko 52% mila total ka means valid ka bhi 52% hai ye absolute percentage hota hai never got confused. So apna 100% method lgao 52% + (52%-5k) + 1000 +16%I.V. = 100% TOTAL

Exam Takeaway: Election wale questions me tree diagram dimaag me set rakh aur ek hi variable me sab solve kar de.

List IList II
Single Variable BaseAlways split 100x into logical branches (Valid, Invalid).

questions.q: If $20\%$ of (P+Q) = $50\%$ of (P-Q), then find the ratio P:Q? (CGL TIER I - 17/09/2025 - Shift 2)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 4. Cross-Product Method

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, percentage aur zero dono side baithe hain, seedha uda de. Dimag me hi $2(P+Q) = 5(P-Q)$ banna chahiye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $2P + 2Q = 5P - 5Q$. Ab variables ek taraf kar le. $2Q$ ke paas $-5Q$ aayega toh $7Q$ banega. Aur $5P$ me se $2P$ gaya toh $3P$. Equation aayi $7Q = 3P$. Pucha kya hai? $P:Q$. Seedha palat de, $P:Q = 7:3$. Khel khatam!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Componendo and Dividendo laga sakta hai agar man kare. $\frac{P+Q}{P-Q} = \frac{5}{2}$. Phir $\frac{P}{Q} = \frac{5+2}{5-2} = \frac{7}{3}$. Ye bhi ek solid tarika hai concept build karne ka.

Exam Takeaway: CGL Tier 1 me aisi speed maintain karni padegi, step-by-step likhne me rank haath se nikal jayegi.

ExpressionSimplified Form
A. Left Hand Side1. $2(P+Q)$
B. Right Hand Side2. $5(P-Q)$

questions.q:
A retail store sells Premium and Casual shirts. The ratio of the price of a Premium shirt to a Casual shirt is 5:2. The ratio of the daily volume of units sold of Premium to Casual shirts is 2:15, generating a fixed combined daily revenue of $50,000.

Due to a market shift, the price of Casual shirts is increased by 20%, but their sales volume drops by 10%. To maintain the exact same total daily revenue of $50,000, by what percentage must the overall revenue generated by Premium shirts decrease?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change + Zero-Sum (JSM) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, yahan Revenue = Price $\times$ Volume hai. Casual shirts ke price aur volume dono me change hai, toh pehle inka single net successive nikal le. $+20$ aur $-10$ ka successive aayega $+8\%$. Ab total revenue ka ratio nikal (Premium : Casual = $10 : 30 = 1 : 3$). Casual (Base 3) ne total 8% ki vridhi ki, yani $+24$ ka deviation. Total fix rakhne ke liye Premium (Base 1) ko seedha $-24$ girna padega. Khel khatam! 50,000 bas darane ke liye hai. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Pehle successive laga, fir JSM se balance kar de. Mathematically :-
$\text{Revenue Ratio (Prem : Cas)} = (5 \times 2) : (2 \times 15) = 10 : 30 = 1 : 3$
$\text{Casual Net Change} = 20 - 10 - \frac{20 \times 10}{100} = +8\%$
$\text{Casual Deviation} = 3 \times 8\% = +24$
$\text{Required Premium Loss} = -24$
$\% \text{ Reduction in Premium} = \frac{24}{1} = 24\%$ Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute numbers maan kar solve karna. Mathematically :-
$\text{Let Total Revenue} = 400x$
$\text{Initial Premium Rev} = 100x, \text{Casual Rev} = 300x$
$\text{New Casual Rev} = 300x \times 1.08 = 324x$
$\text{Required Premium Rev} = 400x - 324x = 76x$
$\text{Reduction in Premium} = 100x - 76x = 24x$
$\% \text{ Reduction} = \frac{24x}{100x} \times 100 = 24\%$ Exam Takeaway: Jab $A \times B$ ke dono components change hon, toh pehle Successive lagakar usko single percentage me compress kar lo. Fir Base Ratio par Zero-Sum lagao. Ye 2 steps me khatam hone wala topper method hai.
Double-Engine StepAction
1. Compress (Successive)$x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$ lagakar single net % nikal lo.
2. Balance (Zero-Sum)Total constant hai toh Base $\times$ Net % Deviation ko dusri taraf transfer kar do.

questions.q: The strength of SSC Aspirants increases and decreases every alternate year. It starts with increase by 20% and thereafter the percentage of increase/decrease is the same. Which of the following is definitely true about the strength of SSC Aspirants in 2000 as compared to that in 1996?
questions.s:
**Core Conceptual Tool:** 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

**Pen-Free Observation:** Dekh bhai, 4 saal ka chain reaction hai: +20\%, -20\%, +20\%, -20\%. Jab bhi same percentage badhe aur ghate, humesha net decrease hi hota hai. Seedha loss ka formula dimag me chamakna chahiye.

**Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach):** Base 100 maan. 4 baar successive chalega: $100 \times 1.2 \times 0.8 \times 1.2 \times 0.8 = 100 \times 0.96 \times 0.96$. 96 ka square nikalna bahut aasan hai (100 se 4 kam hai, toh $96-4=92$ aur $4^2=16$), yani 0.9216. Final value hui 92.16. 100 se ghat kar 92.16 aane me seedha 7.84\% ka decrease!

**Method 2 (Concept Builder):** Successive ko pairs me tod. +20\% aur -20\% ka ek pair net change $\frac{-20^2}{100} = -4\%$ deta hai. Aise 2 pair hain, yani do baar -4\% ka successive. Net change = $-4 - 4 + \frac{(-4)(-4)}{100} = -8 + 0.16 = -7.84\%$.

**Exam Takeaway:** Successive calculation ko fractions ya pairs me todne se answer hawa me nikalta hai. $x$ badhe aur $x$ ghate $\implies$ Humesha $\frac{x^2}{100}$ ka loss.

Pair BreakdownNet Change
A. First 2 Years (+20\%, -20\%)1. $-4\%$ Loss
B. Next 2 Years (+20\%, -20\%)2. $-4\%$ Loss

questions.q: The population of a town is 3,11,250. The ratio of women to men is 43:40. If there are 24% literate among men and 8% literate among women, the total number of literate persons in the town is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool Triggered: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Weighted Average

The 'Pen-Free' Observation First: Pura lamba chauda number 3,11,250 dekh ke darna mat. Ratio dekho: Total 83 parts = 311250. 83 ek prime hai, toh pakka perfectly katega. Base value nikal aur apply kar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai aise karna hai... W = 43x, M = 40x. Total 83x = 311250 $\implies$ x = 3750 (unit digit se hint le, $3 \times 5 = 15$). Literate Men = $24\%$ of $40x = 9.6x$. Literate Women = $8\%$ of $43x = 3.44x$. Total literate = $13.04x$. Total = $13.04 \times 3750 = 48900$. Digital Sum check: 13.04 (DS=8) * 3750 (DS=6) = 48 -> DS=3. Options me check kar, 48900 ka DS = 4+8+9=21 -> 3. Match!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Standard tarika yahi hai bas bacche pehle population ko exact men/women me todte hain, phir percentage nikalte hain. Wo 'Maha-Paap' hai.

Future Exam Takeaway: Variables (x) me hi percentage calculate kar aur end me multiply kar. CDS me time bachana hi asli game hai!

questions.q: In an examination a candidate must secure 40% marks to pass. A candidate, who gets 220 marks, fails by 20 marks. What are the maximum marks for the examination?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ekdum zero level sawal. 220 laaya, 20 se fail ho gaya. Matlab pass 240 pe the. Seedha $40\%$ ki value 240 se link kar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha equating kar without formula. Mathematically :-

$40\% = 220 + 20$

$40\% = 240$

$10\% = 60$

$100\% = 600$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variable x rakh kar pura equation likh. Mathematically :-

$\text{Max Marks} = x$

$\frac{40}{100} \times x = 220 + 20$

$\frac{2}{5}x = 240$

$x = 240 \times \frac{5}{2} = 600$

Exam Takeaway: Passing marks hamesha equate hone chahiye (Marks obtained + Margin = Pass %).

List IList II
Equating Check$P_{marks} = \text{Score} + \text{Deficit}$

questions.q: A solid metallic sphere of radius R is heated so that its radius increases by 10%. Find the approximate percentage increase in its volume. (CHSL TIER I - 25/11/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 2. Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Sphere ki volume radius ke cube ($r^3$) par depend hoti hai. 10% ka multiplier 1.1 hota hai, toh volume multiplier $1.1^3 = 1.331$ aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Dekh bhai TestRipper, radius 1D hai aur Volume 3D me hai. Increment $10\% = \frac{1}{10}$. Toh multiplier hua $\frac{11}{10}$.
Volume ka ratio nikalo: $(\frac{11}{10})^3 = \frac{1331}{1000}$.
Base 1000 se value 1331 ho gayi. Increment = 331. Base 100 par karega toh $= 33.1\%$.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Bohot log isme bas roughly $3 \times 10 = 30\%$, bol dete hain, par exactly calculate ($1.331$) karna hi thik rehta hai precision options ko clear karne ke liye.

Exam Takeaway: Bhai tu SSC ki tayari kar raha hai, cubes 15 tak tere dimaag me chhape hone chahiye. $11^3 = 1331$ toh sabse common hai.

questions.q: A bacteria culture increases by $20\%$ every hour for 3 hours, then decreases by $10\%$ in the 4th hour, and finally increases by $25\%$ in the 5th hour. If the initial count was 5,000, what will be the approximate count after 5 hours?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Seedha fraction denominator check kar, $125 \times 10 \times 4 = 5000$, principal se exact cut jayega. Ans decimals me nahi aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Chain bana - $5000 \times (6/5)^3 \times (9/10) \times (5/4) = 5000 \times (216/125) \times (9/10) \times (5/4)$. Base cut hone pe final bacha $216 \times 9/2 \times 5...$ simply solve kar $9720$ exact value aayegi.

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic tree bana kar successive badha. Pehle $+20\%$, fir $+20\%$... bohot time waste hoga. Fractions rule is the only sensible way.

Exam Takeaway: Denominators ka product hamesha initial value ko set up karne ke liye diya hota hai taaki easily simplify ho sake.

RateMultiplier
$+20\%$$6/5$
$-10\%$$9/10$

questions.q: In a class of 60 students, $40\%$ are girls. The average weight of boys is 62 kg and that of girls is 55 kg. What is the average weight of the whole class?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 60 students mazdoori karne ke liye diya hai. Total bacho se hume koi matlab nahi, sirf ratio se khelna hai!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Girls $40\%$ toh Boys $60\%$. Ratio Boys:Girls $= 3:2$. JSM method lagayenge. Maan le puri class ka average $55$ hai. Ab Boys ka average $62$ hai, yani $55$ se $7$ zyada. $3$ ladko pe total deviation aaya $+21$. Is total deviation ko total baccho ($3+2 = 5$) me baant de. $+21/5 = +4.2$. Base 55 me ye 4.2 jod de, final average $59.2$ kg. Pen-free hack!

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Weighted average ka basic laga le. Total bacche $5$ unit hain. Total sum $= 3 \times 62 + 2 \times 55 = 186 + 110 = 296$. Average $= \frac{296}{5} = 59.2$ kg. Number chote the toh ye bhi jaldi ho jata.

Exam Takeaway: Absolute values tabhi use karni hain jab absolute answer pucha ho. Averages aur percentages hamesha ratio par nikal jate hain.

Deviation FlowCalculation
A. Base Assumed1. $55$ kg
B. Extra Share2. $\frac{21}{5} = 4.2$ kg

questions.q: Three candidates P, Q and R contested an election. Out of the total votes on a voter list $25\%$ did not vote and $20\%$ of the polled votes were invalid. R got 7500 votes which were $25\%$ more than that of what Q got. If P got only $45\%$ of the total votes, then find out the number of votes the winner got?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling (Chain Process Breakdown)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, 'Valid votes' ka distribution bada lamba fraction set le raha hai. Ulta mat soch, percentage flow ke order me bas fractions kaat-te ja.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total list maan lo $100\%$. Valid residual nikalo aur Q+R ke sum ko balance bache % se equate karo. Boom!

Mathematically :-
$$ Total = 100\\% \\\\ Valid = 100\\% \\times 0.75 \\times 0.80 = 60\\% \\\\ Q = \\frac{7500}{1.25} = 6000 \\\\ Q + R = 13500 \\\\ P = 45\\% \\implies Q+R = 60\\% - 45\\% = 15\\% \\\\ 15\\% = 13500 \\implies 45\\% = 40500 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Pure equations maan kar solve karo. Exam nikalne ki umeed chod dena tab!

Mathematically :-
$$ Valid = x \\times 0.75 \\times 0.8 = 0.6x \\\\ P = 0.45x \\\\ Q+R = 0.6x - 0.45x = 0.15x \\\\ 0.15x = 13500 \\implies x = 90000 \\\\ P = 0.45 \\times 90000 = 40500 $$

Exam Takeaway: Aise lambe statements ko line diagram aur valid % residual calculation se todna sabse powerful technique hai.

List I (Vote Split Share)List II (Percentage out of Total List)
A. Valid Votes1. $60\%$
B. Candidate P's Share2. $45\%$

questions.q: A salesman has done total sale of Rs. (x + 17000) and the rate of commission up to Rs. (x + 5000) is $13.33\%$ and after Rs. (x + 5000), he gets some bonus amount which is equal to Rs. (x - 8000). If the bonus rate is $16.66\%$ on the amount exceeding Rs. (x + 5000), then find his total sale.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 5. Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh TestRipper, 'x' dekh ke darna nahi hai. Dono range '(x+17000)' aur '(x+5000)' form me hain. Difference lega toh x gayab! Seedha excess amount nikal aayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Excess sale = $(x + 17000) - (x + 5000) = 12000$. Bonus mila is excess ka $16.66\%$ yani $1/6$. Bonus $= 2000$. Question me bonus $(x - 8000)$ hai. $x - 8000 = 2000 \implies x = 10000$. Total sale thi $x+17000$, seedha 27000 answer mark kar!

Mathematically :-
$\text{Excess} = (x + 17000) - (x + 5000) = 12000$
$\text{Bonus} = 12000 \times \frac{1}{6} = 2000$
$x - 8000 = 2000 \implies x = 10000$
$\text{Total} = 10000 + 17000 = 27000$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Algebraically poori condition likh, rate of commission wagera add kar. Uski yahan zaroorat nahi thi kyunki excess bonus direct de rakha hai aur bonus ki condition bhi.

Mathematically :-
$\text{Total Sale} = S = x + 17000$
$\text{Bonus} = \frac{1}{6}(S - (x + 5000))$
$\text{Bonus} = \frac{12000}{6} = 2000$
$x - 8000 = 2000 \implies x = 10000$
$S = 27000$

Exam Takeaway: Variables dekh kar panic nahi karna, variables difference lete hi khud eliminate ho jate hain.

StepValue
Excess Sale$12000$
Bonus$2000$

questions.q: The area of a regular triangle increases by $44\%$. By what percentage did the side length increase? (CGL TIER I - 22/09/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, options pe nazar maar. Hamein formula pata hai $a + b + \frac{ab}{100}$ lagta hai dimensions pe. Option $20$ utha aur mind me calc kar, $20 + 20 + \frac{400}{100} = 44$. Aise nikalna chahiye answer!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Area humesha 2D hota hai. Ye sabse safe hack hai. Mathematically :- $$ A_1:A_2 = 100:144 \\ S_1:S_2 = \sqrt{100}:\sqrt{144} = 10:12 \\ \% \text{ Increase} = \frac{12-10}{10} \times 100 = 20\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let side increase be $x\%$. Quadratic form hoke time jayega. Mathematically :- $$ x + x + \frac{x^2}{100} = 44 \\ 2x + \frac{x^2}{100} = 44 \\ x^2 + 200x - 4400 = 0 \\ (x - 20)(x + 220) = 0 \implies x = 20 $$

Exam Takeaway: 2D aur 3D changes ko wapas 1D side ratio me badalna ho toh humesha square root ya cube root le kar base scaling kiya kar.

DimensionRelation Conversion
A. Length/Side (1D)1. Ratio $x$
B. Area (2D)2. Ratio $x^2$

questions.q: A man's annual income has increased by $\text{Rs. } 2$ lakhs but the tax on Income that he has to pay has reduced from $20\%$ to $16\%$. He now pays the same amount of tax as before. What is his increased income (in Rs. lakhs)?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, bol raha hai tax amount same hai. Income $\times$ Rate = Tax. Jab Tax constant hota hai, Income aur Rate inverse ratio me aa jate hain, seedha ud jayega ratio se!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Jab Amount same ho, toh Income aur Tax Rate ek dusre ke inversely proportional hote hain! Ekdum direct udana hai ise! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Tax Rate Ratio} = 20:16 = 5:4 \\ \text{Income Ratio} = 4:5 \\ \text{Difference} = 1 \text{ unit} = 2 \text{ lakhs} \\ \text{New Income} = 5 \text{ units} = 10 \text{ lakhs} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let initial income be $x$ lakh. According to the question, normal equation banegi. Mathematically :- $$ 20\% \times x = 16\% \times (x + 2) \\ 0.20x = 0.16x + 0.32 \\ 0.04x = 0.32 \\ x = 8 \\ \text{New Income} = x + 2 = 10 $$

Exam Takeaway: Arithmetic me variables ki jagah Ratio inversions lagana time bachata hai jab product constant ho.

MetricRatio Transition
A. Tax Rate Ratio1. $5:4$
B. Income Ratio2. $4:5$

questions.q: In a group of 50 people, 28 have traveled to Europe, 31 have traveled to Asia, and 10 have traveled to both continents. How many people have not traveled to either continent?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: 3. JSM / Deviation (Set Theory) Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, basic Venn diagram ya Set Theory ka sawal hai. Values choti hain, pen ki zaroorat hi nahi, mind me hi add-subtract kar. Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Total log jo kahin na kahin gaye hain = Europe + Asia - Both. Yani $28 + 31 - 10 = 49$. Total log group me $50$ the. Toh kitne log kahin nahi gaye? Seedha $50 - 49 = 1$. Secondon ka game hai! Method 2 (Concept Builder): Venn Diagram imagine kar. Beech me 'Both' wale $10$ rakh. 'Only Europe' wale bache $28 - 10 = 18$. 'Only Asia' wale bache $31 - 10 = 21$. Ab sabko jod le: Only E (18) + Only A (21) + Both (10) = 49. Total 50 me se 49 gaye toh bacha sirf 1. Aise concept build hota hai. Exam Takeaway: Jab tak 3 set wala sawal na ho, Venn diagram mat banana. Seedha $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$ lagaya kar.
CategoryPeople
1. Traveled Anywhere$28 + 31 - 10 = 49$
2. Traveled Nowhere$50 - 49 = 1$

questions.q: Salary of A increased by 8% in the year 2015 as compared to 2014 and decreased by 6% in the year 2016 as compared to 2015. If his salary was Rs. 2,34,778 in 2016, his salary (round off to nearest whole number) in 2014 was:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change.

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $+8\%$ aur $-6\%$ ka net lagbhag $+1.5\%$ ayega. Agar value thodi badhkar $2.34$ Lakh hui hai, toh original pakka thodi chhoti hogi, options se seedha eliminate maar.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Successive formula laga aur options eliminate kar. Mazdoori mat kar. Mathematically :-

$\text{Net} = 8 - 6 - \frac{48}{100} = +1.52\%$

$101.52\% = 234778$

$\text{Base} \approx \frac{234778}{1.0152} < 234778$

$\text{Only option < 234k is 231263}$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic multiplying factor wali equation likh kar reverse aaja. Mathematically :-

$x \times 1.08 \times 0.94 = 234778$

$x \times 1.0152 = 234778$

$x = 231262.8 \approx 231263$

Exam Takeaway: SSC CGL intentionally aise options set karta hai. Exact calculation se pehle approximation se options hata, exam clear yahi approach karayegi.

List IList II
Successive Formula$x + y + \frac{xy}{100}$
